1.consolidated_definition: Expectorar: Sustantivo que designa el acto de expulsar con dificultad saliva o secreciones del tracto respiratorio a través de la boca.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Expectoration: Noun that denotes the act of expelling with difficulty saliva or respiratory tract secretions through the mouth.
